chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Abdullah ibn Ahmad, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ibn Sinan, from Sabiq ibn al-Walid, from al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays, that Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said:
Hamidah is purified from impurities like an ingot of gold. The angels never ceased guarding her until she was delivered to me as an honor from Allah for me and for the Divine Authority after me.

key_terms.الذَّهَبِ: gold, used here as a comparison for purity
key_terms.الْحُجَّةِ: the Divine Authority, referring to the Imam
key_terms.حَمِيدَةُ: Hamidah, the woman being praised in the narration
key_terms.سَبِيكَةِ: an ingot or refined piece of metal

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in al-Kafi say about Hamidah, the mother connected to Imam Musa عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith praises Hamidah with exceptional purity and describes her as being specially guarded by the angels. It presents her arrival as a divine honor from Allah connected to the Imam and to the hujjah who would come after him.
